summary: Rep. Jeff Crank is endorsed by AIPAC as a pro-Israel candidate supporting a strong U.S.-Israel relationship. His public framing centers Israeli victimhood: on the October 7 anniversary he called it the 'deadliest attack on the Jewish people since the Holocaust' without mentioning Gaza, and a 2025 constituent letter acknowledged that attack while omitting Palestinian deaths and displacement. He co-sponsored H.R. 1007, incorporating the IHRA definition into Title VI education enforcement. Vote for Peace rated him Opposed in the general.
